title: [4.4 dev6 - Windows] All button signals are broken in exported exe
body:
### Tested versions (All win 11 forward+) **When creating & exporting new project** - Reproducible in Godot 4.4 dev 6 - Works fine for same MRE in Godot 4.4 dev 5
**When loading & exporting projects from dev 5 -> 6** - Inconsistently reproducible, more testing needed to triangulate cause - All affected projects broken in dev 6 remains broken when loaded back in Godot 4.4 dev 5 --- ### System information Godot Engine v4.4.dev6.official.1f47e4c4e - Vulkan 1.3.280 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER --- ### Issue description All button's signals cuts off w/o any error on console in dev6 w/ windows export. Once project is loaded into dev6, such behavior persists back in dev5. Workaround I found to fix project back in dev5 is following: for **_EVERY_** scene that **_OWNS_** buttons (not inherited one, not instanced one) do: 1. force changes to scene (i.e. adding pointless `Control` node in scene's root) 2. save, export and verify it works. (If not try reloading/refreshing project) 3. remove 1st step's change and re-export. This seems to fix simple scenes or inherited ones but instanced buttons seems to be troublesome. --- ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create button 2. Connect signals 3. Export for x86_64 window 4. All button signals are broken or 1. Load older version's projects 3. Export for x86_64 window 4. All button signals are broken --- ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) MRE: [mre_44_dev5_6.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18104452/mre_44_dev5_6.zip)
Entire MRE source code & structure for reproducing without MRE just in case: ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9b34d4d-3f34-406b-8174-6b1a868f2e4c) ```gdscript extends Control @onready var state_label: Label = %ButtonStateLabel @onready var count_label: Label = %PressCountLabel var count: int = 0 func _on_button_button_down() -> void: self.state_label.text = "Button State: DOWN" func _on_button_button_up() -> void: self.state_label.text = "Button State: UP" func _on_button_pressed() -> void: count += 1 self.count_label.text = "Press Count: %s" % count ```
Video of MRE demonstration https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5982d15-860c-4ebe-8c16-75bbf9585079
